finding.issue: The new upgrade staging path only permits exact replay when list(marker.parent.glob('*.json')) == [marker]. That rejects the same valid staged upgrade whenever the repository also preserves any legitimate historical migration handoff JSON. Python Agent already has preserved completed source-bootstrap migration history from TASK-255. First staging can append the new edge because _stage_migration_handoff delegates history validation to _require_no_active_migration, but a carrier replay after the new marker exists and before completion will fail solely because older immutable migration evidence remains. This violates the hard requirement that exact replay of the same active edge may reuse idempotent handoff behavior and can strand the bounded TASK-259 staging path after a transport interruption.
